Verified `nw.Int32`/`nw.Float32` exist in the installed narwhals dtypes module.

```python
import narwhals as nw


def convert_columns(df):
    nw_df = nw.from_native(df)
    result = nw_df.with_columns(
        nw.col("user_id").cast(nw.Int32),
        nw.col("score").cast(nw.Float32),
    )
    return nw.to_native(result)
```
